question_text: Makati City purchased a fire truck costing ₱4,800,000 to be paid in 12 equal monthly installments with an annual interest rate of 6% compounded monthly. What is the monthly amortization? (Use the formula: M = P × [r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1], where r = monthly interest rate, n = number of payments)
